seo.description_so: U dir Garoowe oo dhan daqiiqado gudahood. Xirmooyin, cunto, dukumeenti iyo alaab ilaa 30 kg, oo leh koodh xaqiijin ah oo qaataha.
seo.description_en: Send it across Garowe in minutes. Parcels, food, documents and shopping up to 30 kg, with a recipient verification code.

so.headline: U dir Garoowe oo dhan daqiiqado gudahood.
so.sub: Dir xirmooyin, cunto, dukumeenti iyo alaab. Isla darawallada BajGo ayaa qaada oo gaarsiiya, qiimahana waxaad arkaysaa ka hor.

en.headline: Send it across Garowe in minutes.
en.sub: Send packages, food, documents and shopping. The same BajGo drivers collect and deliver, and you see the fare first.

steps.title: Sharax xirmada
steps.body: Dooro nooca iyo cabbirka, qor magaca iyo lambarka qaataha, oo haddii aad rabto sawir ku dar.

steps.title: Dooro meelaha
steps.body: Meesha laga qaadayo iyo meesha la geynayo. Qiimaha ayaa lagu tusayaa ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.

steps.title: La soco xirmada
steps.body: Darawalku wuu soo qaadaa, adiguna waxaad arkaysaa meesha ay joogto si toos ah.

steps.title: Xaqiijinta qaataha
steps.body: Qaatuhu wuxuu helayaa koodh 4-lambar ah oo fariin ah. Darawalku wuxuu geliyaa ka hor intuusan dhiibin.

steps.title: Describe the parcel
steps.body: Choose the category and size, add the recipient's name and number, and a photo if you like.

steps.title: Choose the places
steps.body: Where to collect and where to deliver. The fare is shown before you confirm.

steps.title: Track the parcel
steps.body: The driver collects it, and you see where it is live.

steps.title: Recipient verification
steps.body: The recipient receives a 4-digit code by SMS. The driver enters it before handing over.

so.title: Noocyada, cabbirrada iyo waxyaabaha mamnuuca ah
so.body: Culeyska ugu badan waa 30 kg. Xirmadu waa inay ku habboonaato kursiga dambe ee Bajaajka oo si fiican loo xidhay.

en.title: Categories, sizes and prohibited items
en.body: The maximum weight is 30 kg. The parcel must fit on the rear seat of a Bajaaj and be properly packaged.

so.title: Qiyaas qiimaha dirista
so.body: Qiimaha dirista wuxuu la mid yahay qiimaha safarka: wuxuu ku salaysan yahay masaafada.

en.title: Estimate a delivery fare
en.body: Delivery pricing is the same as ride pricing: it is based on distance.

so.title: Akhri shuruudaha dirista
so.body: Waxa aan masuul ka nahay, waxa aan masuul ka ahayn, iyo sida loo wajaho xirmooyinka aan la gaarsiin karin.
so.label: Shuruudaha dirista

en.title: Read the delivery terms
en.body: What we are responsible for, what we are not, and what happens when a parcel cannot be delivered.
en.label: Delivery terms
